z-m-30-01.title: Maxaa ka dambeeya 1, 2, 4?
z-m-30-01.topic: Awoodaha matrix: imisa qiime ayaa loo baahan yahay si qaab loo xaqiijiyo?
z-m-30-01.goal: Ogow in awoodaha matrix, dhowr xeer ay ku habboon karaan tiro yar oo qiimayaal ah, shaandhee xeerarka musharaxiinta ah oo dib u eeg xukunkaaga markaad socoto, oo sharax inaad hubin kartid qaaciddo guud kaliya kadib marka aad hesho sababta (qaabdhismeedka).
z-m-30-01.material: B waa matrix 2×2, afarta galmo ee ay leedahay (safka 1 tiirka 1, safka 1 tiirka 2, safka 2 tiirka 1, safka 2 tiirka 2) dhammaantood waa 1. B^n waa matrix-ka aad hesho marka aad B ku dhufato n jeer. Dhammaan galmooyinku waa tirooyin dhab ah n-na waa tiro buuxda oo ah 1 ama ka badan. Laba saaxiib ayaa ka hadlaya galmooyinka B³. Mid ayaa yidhi, "Galmooyinka B¹ iyo B² waa 1 iyo 2, sidaas darteed B³ waa 3," kan kalena wuxuu yidhi, "Weli ma hubo. Aan ku dhufanno wax badan." Mar kasta oo xog la muujiyo, dib u eeg xukunkaaga ama ku sii adkow.
z-m-30-01.thinking.0: Marka xeer laga guud ka dhigayo xog yar, sidoo kale tixgelinta xeerarka kale ee suurtagalka ah
z-m-30-01.thinking.1: Hagaajinta xukunkaaga iyo heerka kalsoonida adigoo raacaya macluumaad cusub
z-m-30-01.thinking.2: Helista xariiqda ugu horreysa ee khaldanta xalka dhexdiisa oo sharaxaadda sababta
z-m-30-01.thinking.3: Samaynta qaaciddo guud adigoo isticmaalaya xarfo (p, n) oo qorista sababta
z-m-30-01.prereq.0: Wax-ku-dhufashada matrix-yada 2×2 (hal galmo oo wax-ku-dhufasho ah = wadarta wax-ku-dhufashada galmooyinka hal saf oo matrix-ka hore iyo hal tiir oo matrix-ka dambe) iyo awoodaha A^n = A lagu dhufto n jeer
z-m-30-01.prereq.1: Akhrinta tibaaxaha ka kooban xarfaha n iyo p iyo helista qaabab tiro fudud
z-m-30-01.prereq.2: Malo-awaal nidaamka dugsiga: H2 ee hawshani waa summad adkaansho oo soo saarista keliya mana aha in Wasaaradda Waxbarashadu ay macluumaadkan u meelaysay darajo gaar ah. Waxaan u malaynaynaa inuu yimaado isla markii wax-ku-dhufashada matrix la bartay, loona baahnayn induction ama determinant.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.prompt: Xogta waxaa la muujiyaa hal tallaabo mar kasta. Tallaabo kasta, dooro xukunkaaga hadda ee ku saabsan waxa ay noqon doonaan galmooyinka awoodaha B.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.hint.0: Tallaabo kasta, qor xeer kasta oo ku habboon tirooyinka ilaa hadda, oo isbarbar dhig kuwa macluumaadka cusubi meesha ka saaro.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.hint.1: Hubi haddii aad dooratay adigoo ka fikiraya hal xeer oo keliya, mise aad sidoo kale tixgelisay xeerarka kale.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.info: B¹ waa B laftiisa, sidaas darteed afarta galmo dhammaantood waa 1. Markii B² si toos ah loo dhufto, afarta galmo dhammaantood waxay ahaayeen 2.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Galmooyinka B³ ma yihiin? Dooro xukunkaaga hadda.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Labada xog waxay sharaxayaan 3 iyo 4 labadaba. Waxaad qaadan kartaa hal xeer sida 'hypothesis shaqo,' laakiin kahor hubinta waa macquul in xukunkaaga furan lagu hayo.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Dhammaan galmooyinku waa 3. Kadib 1, 2, xeerka kordhinta 1 ayaa sii socda
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Waxaa jira xeerar ku habboon 1, 2 ka sokow 'kordhi 1.' Annagoo haysanna laba qodob oo xog ah oo keliya, way hore tahay in lagu go'aamiyo hal xeer.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Dhammaan galmooyinku waa 4. Kadib 1, 2, xeerka labanlaabidda ayaa sii socda
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Xeerka laba-laabmidda sidoo kale wuxuu ku habboon yahay 1, 2, laakiin sidaas oo kale 'kordhi 1'. Ogow inay hore tahay in la doorto mid keliya oo lagu hubsado.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ma go'aamin karno 3 iyo 4 hadda, sidaa darteed hubi adigoo si toos ah u dhufanaya B³
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Waxaad aqoonsatay in labada xog ay ku habboon yihiin dhowr xeer oo aad dib u dhigtay xukunkaaga. Xataa waxaad ka fikirtay ficilka hubinta (ku dhufashada si toos ah).
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Dhammaan gelitaannadu waa 2. Waa matrix leh dhammaan gelitaanno isku mid ah, sidaa darteed qiimuhu mar dambe ma beddelmo
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: B², qiimuhu horey ayuu uga beddelmay 1 ilaa 2. Gelitaannada oo isku mid ah macnaheedu maaha qiimuhu mar dambe ma beddelmo.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Marka B³ si toos ah loo dhufto, afarta gelitaan dhammaantood waxay ahaayeen 4. Ilaa hadda waa 1, 2, 4. Xeerka ku habboon tirooyinkan maaha 'laba-laabmid' oo keliya. Ku darista labada qiime ee hore kadibna ku darista 1 waxay siinaysaa 1, 2, 4, 7, ..., kanna wuu ku habboon yahay.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Mahad B³, 'kordhi 1' waa la baabi'iyey. Laakiin xeerka laba-laabmidda iyo xeerka 1, 2, 4, 7 lama kala saari karo ilaa B⁴ la xisaabiyo. Waxaad u baahan tahay inaad ururiso xog dheeraad ah ama aad hesho sababta.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ku go'aami xeerka laba-laabmidda oo qor in dhammaan gelitaannada B⁴ ay yihiin 8
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Waa run in saddexda qiime ku habboon yihiin laba-laabmidda, laakiin xeerka 1, 2, 4, 7 sidoo kale wuu ku habboon yahay. Weli ma kala saarin labada.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: U qaado 4 ee B³ khalad xisaabeed oo ilaali xeerkii ugu horreeyay ee dhammaantood yihiin 3
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Haddii aad qiimaha si toos ah loo xisaabiyey ku eedayso khalad, waxaad ilaalin kartaa xukunkaagii koowaad laakiin aasaas ma lihid. Dib u hubinta xisaabinta way ka duwan tahay in la tuuro.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Waxaa jira dhowr xeer, sidaa darteed xogtan ha qiyaasin gabi ahaanba
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: 'Kordhi 1' mar dambe ma ku habboona. In xeerarka haray tiradoodu yaraatay sidoo kale waa macluumaad.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Ka tuur 'kordhi 1,' oo kala saar labada xeer ee haray B⁴
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Waxaad ka tuurtay xeerka aan xogta ku habboonayn oo xataa waxaad ka fikirtay hab lagu kala saaro xeerarka haray.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Waxaan raadiyey sabab. U dhig dhammaan afarta gelitaan ee B^n ay yihiin isla tiro k. Hal gelitaan oo B^(n+1) = B^n × B waa (k × 1) + (k × 1) = 2k. Waa isla xisaabin afarta gelitaan dhammaantood. Dhammaan gelitaannada B¹ waa 1.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Hadda sidee u xukuntaa gelitaannada B^n iyo B⁵?
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Qaabka ay dhammaan gelitaannadu isku mid yihiin ayaa la ilaaliyaa mar kasta qiimuhuna wuu laba-laabmaa, sidaa darteed gelitaannada B^n waa 2^(n−1). Xukunka bilowgii loo daayay furan 'ma waa 3 mise 4' wuxuu cidhiidhmay siday u kala horreeyaan xog → xeerarka musharrax ah → sabab. Arday si toos ah u xisaabiyey B⁴ wuxuu gaadhaa isla gunaanad.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Gelitaannada B^n dhammaantood waa n, kuwa B⁵ na dhammaantood waa 5
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Xeerka n horey ayuu uga baxay B³. Sidoo kale ma ku habboona macluumaadka cusub (2k mar kasta oo aan dhufanno).
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Gelitaannada B^n dhammaantood waa 2^(n−1), kuwa B⁵ na dhammaantood waa 16
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Waxaad ku xidhay ilaa sababta 'ku dhufasho kasta waxay siinaysaa 2k' oo ku dabaqmaysa n kasta.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Waxay u badan tahay inay tahay 2^(n−1), laakiin ma hubin doono ka hor intaan si toos ah u dhufan B⁵
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Dabeecadda ah rabitaanka hubinta way fiicantahay. Laakiin macluumaadka cusub waa sabab ku run ah n kasta. Ka fikir sida sababtaasi u saameyso kalsoonidaada.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.o.d: B⁴ waa 7, sidaa darteed B⁵ dhammaantood waa 12
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Waxaad ilaaliseen xeerka 1, 2, 4, 7. Hubi haddii uu ku habboon yahay macluumaadka cusub ee k noqonayo 2k.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.reflect: Laga bilaabo dib u dhigidda xukunkaaga bilowgii ilaa kalsoonida dhammaadka, maxaa beddelay kalsoonidaada? Maxaa farqi ay samaysay ururinta saddex xog oo kale iyo helitaanka 'sababta' kalsoonidaada?
z-m-30-01.s.s2.prompt: Hayun, saaxiibka fasalka, wuxuu helay gelitaannada awoodaha C = 3B (matrix afarta gelitaan dhammaantood yihiin 3) sida hoos ku xusan. Dooro sadarka ugu horreeya ee khaldama.
z-m-30-01.s.s2.hint.0: Dooro mid ka mid ah gelitaannada C oo si toos ah u xisaabi gelitaanka (safka 1, tiirka 1) ee C laba jeer lagu dhufto.
z-m-30-01.s.s2.hint.1: Isbarbar dhig qiimaha si toos ah loo xisaabiyey iyo qiimaha sadar kasta oo hel sadarka ugu horreeya ee ay ku kala duwan yihiin.
z-m-30-01.s.s2.line.1: Dhammaan gelitaannada B² waa 2, sidaa darteed dhammaan gelitaannada C² waa 3 × 2 = 6.
z-m-30-01.s.s2.line.2: Si le'eg C³ = 3B³, dhammaan gelitaannada B³ na waa 4, sidaa darteed dhammaan gelitaannada C³ waa 3 × 4 = 12.
z-m-30-01.s.s2.explain: Sadarka 1, joogtada 3 waxay ku jirtaa hal mar labada qodob kasta, laakiin hal mar oo keliya ayaa la soo saaray. (3B)(3B) 3 waxay u muuqataa laba jeer, sidaa darteed C² = 9B², dhammaan gelitaannadana waa 9 × 2 = 18. Haddii aad si toos ah u labajibbaarto C oo aad xisaabiso hal gelitaan oo keliya, 3×3 + 3×3 = 18, sidaa darteed waad xaqiijin kartaa inay ka duwan tahay 6. Sadarrada 2 ilaa 4 waxay dhaxleen tibaaxda sadarka 1 waana khalad. Sadarka 3 sidoo kale, isla sabab: C³ = 27B³ gelitaannadu na waa 108.
z-m-30-01.s.s3.prompt: Markan, tixgeli matrix P afarta gelitaan dhammaantood yihiin p (p waa tiro dhan oo togan). Tibaax ku muuji gelitaannada P^n, P oo n jeer la dhufto, p iyo n, oo qor sababta aad sidaas u odhan karto.
z-m-30-01.s.s3.hint.0: p=1 iyo p=2, si toos ah u dhufo P² oo isbarbar dhig gelitaannada.
z-m-30-01.s.s3.hint.1: Qor sida tibaax sida gelitaannada P² ugu xidhan yihiin gelitaannada P iyo p, oo hubi haddii isla wax ay dhacaan P³.
z-m-30-01.s.s3.placeholder: Tusaale: Gelitaannada P^n waa ... Sababtoo ah ...
z-m-30-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma gelitaanka 2^(n−1) ee B^n wuxuu mar kale ka soo baxaa tibaaxdayda marka p=1?
z-m-30-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma hubisay inay waafaqdo qiimayaasha si toos ah loo dhufto adigoo geliyay n=1 iyo n=2?
z-m-30-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma qortay qaab-dhismeedka sababta, sida 'sababta xisaabinta hal gelitaan ay ku filan tahay' ama 'adigoo B soo saaraya'?
z-m-30-01.s.s3.model.0: Gelitaannada P^n dhammaantood waa p^n × 2^(n−1). Haddii aan qorno P = pB, markaas P^n = p^n B^n, gelitaannada B^n na mar kasta way laba-laabmaan.
z-m-30-01.s.s3.model.1: Sida p, 2p², 4p³, ..., gelitaannadu mar kasta oo aan hal mar dhufanno waxay noqdaan 2p jeer ka weyn. Afarta gelitaan waxay ilaaliyaan isla qaab hal gelitaan na waa p×k + p×k = 2pk, sidaa darteed gelitaannada P^n waa p × (2p)^(n−1).
z-m-30-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Habka ka bilaabma isbeddelka hal ku dhufasho. Tibaaxdu waa isku mid jawaabtii hore.
